verdict.rationale: Granola runs some fixed automations in the background: overnight pre-meeting briefs, auto-drafted follow-up emails, and HubSpot auto-sync of foldered notes. User-defined automations depend mainly on the third-party Zapier integration or building your own agents on the API. Recipes and Chat workflows are user-invoked rather than autonomous. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/trigger builder, docs on scheduling or event-triggered custom agent runs inside Granola, and independent hands-on corroboration that the background automations work reliably.
